heard: NASA hauled a space shuttle through city streets. Endeavour had already flown nearly 123 million space miles. It was built from spare parts left behind by other orbiters. But its 12-mile journey through Los Angeles took 68 hours. Crews cut down over 400 trees to clear the wide wings. Workers shut off power lines and pulled down traffic lights. The spacecraft squeezed past apartment buildings with inches of clearance. Top speed for the entire trip was just two miles per hour.
